extName.message: StartLogo - Custom Search Home Logo (CJK Ready)

extDesc.message: Replace the logo on the Google search home page with your own text (Korean, Japanese, Chinese, emoji), an image, or a live clock.

textPlaceholder.message: e.g. Hello / 안녕하세요 / こんにちは / 你好

textHint.message: Korean, Japanese, Chinese and emoji all work

imageHint.message: Choose an image from your computer (recommended height ~115px)

clockHint.message: Replaces the logo with a live HH:MM:SS clock.

colorTitle.message: Solid color (used when multicolor is off)
